warnings.text: 301005 UTC Oct 26 1. NAVAREA I WARNINGS IN FORCE AT 301000 UTC OCT 2026: 2026 SERIES: 61, 183, 235, 237. NOTES: A. TEXTS OF NAVAREA I WARNINGS ISSUED EACH WEEK ARE PUBLISHED IN WEEKLY EDITIONS OF THE ADMIRALTY NOTICES TO MARINERS BULLETIN (ANMB). B. NAVAREA I WARNINGS LESS THAN 42 DAYS OLD (235/26 ONWARD) ARE PROMULGATED VIA ENHANCED GROUP CALL (EGC) AND/OR RELEVANT NAVTEX TRANSMITTERS. C.
